facts.text: BSc Computer Engineering, Fictional State University (FSU), Nigeria, 2020 to 2025.
CGPA 4.30 out of 5.00, Second Class Upper.
Embedded Systems Intern, BrightGrid Solar, 5 months in 2024. Wrote data logging firmware for a solar sensor board.
SunTrack: low cost solar panel monitoring system built with ESP32 microcontroller and wireless sensors. Tested on 3 rooftop panels. Final year project.
SunTrack dashboard: Python web dashboard that shows panel output over time.
Organized the FSU campus hackathon with 120 participants.
Captained the FSU football team for 2 seasons.
Volunteered as a coding teacher at Community Secondary School. Taught Python to 40 students over 200 hours across 2 years.
Assistant coordinator of the FSU Tech Club for the 2023 to 2024 session.
Family income was too low to pay full fees in second year, so tutored students on weekends to cover costs.
